description: This file defines the implementation class 'ue_scheduler_impl' for a user equipment (UE) scheduler in a wireless communication system, including its internal 'cell_context' class, and declares methods and members related to scheduling, cell management, and event handling.

classes.name: ue_scheduler_impl
classes.description: Final class implementing the UE scheduler interface, managing cell contexts, scheduling strategies, and event handling for multiple cells.

classes.name: cell_context
classes.description: Nested class representing the context and state of a single cell within the UE scheduler, including its resource allocators, schedulers, event manager, and configuration.

methods.name: ue_scheduler_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scheduler with a given expert configuration.

methods.name: do_add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell scheduler based on provided creation request parameters.

methods.name: do_start_cell
methods.description: Starts scheduling for a specified cell.

methods.name: do_stop_cell
methods.description: Stops scheduling for a specified cell.

methods.name: run_slot_impl
methods.description: Executes scheduling logic for a given slot.
